hero.caption: View of Powerscourt Deerpark and Waterfall at Ride Rock, Crone Woods near Enniskerry, County Wicklow, Ireland. At 121 metres, the waterfall is the tallest in Ireland. It is fed by the River Dargle which rises in the Glensoulan valley near Djouce mountain, which can be seen in background.

images.caption: A part of The Japanese Garden, Powerscourt. This garden was laid out on reclaimed bogland in 1908. A series of concentric paths lead the visitor around the garden which features a pagoda, stone lanterns and several bridges over the stream.
